sentences.text: 2. The present appeal has been preferred:-

"against the Judgment of acquittal dated 03-12- 2020 passed by Learned District &
Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura, in Criminal Appeal Case No. 05/2019 arising out of Sheikhpura P.S. Case No. 110 of 2012 under Section 419, 420, 406, 467, 468 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 wherein the Learned Sessions & District Judge has overruled the judgment of conviction passed by the Learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Sheikhpura dated 11.06.2019 whereby the Trial Court had convicted the Respondent No. 2 under section 419, 420, 467 & 468 of the IPC and Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ) No.195 of 2024(5) dt.09-04-2025 sentenced him to simple imprisonment of 2 years along with fine of Rs. 2,000/-; each under section 419, 420 and 6 months along with fine Rs. 1,000/-; each under section 467, 468 of the IPC.

Further, in default of payment of fine one month each sentence was awarded."
